criteria.requirement: Five reserved 3203x discriminators have distinct t topics, canonical family entries, manifest justifications, web mirrors, and read-auth classifications.
Successful package intent/claim/approval and signed package-handler mutations publish one confidential canonical state record each, without a second mutation path.
Tool intent, denylist, and profile mutations publish once and removals tombstone the live coordinate.
Notification log create/update/delete publish one bounded, encrypted per-channel window; no unbounded per-log-line coordinates.
MCP package, tool, and notification reads use validated local signed state and retain legacy result shapes without a database.
